# ZWISERFIT

> ZWISERFIT builds tools that sit on the user's side. Our incentive is aligned with the user's interest — we save you money, and we take no markup, no telemetry, no cut. LAO is our first open-source product — not our last.

## LAO — Lineage Anchored Ontology

An independent third party between the LLM and the Runtime. It wraps existing calls (never replaces them): per-task model selection, cache-aware token optimization, intent lock, experience-anchored answer calibration, behavioral memory. LLM vendors sell tokens; runtimes move them; LAO watches the door for you.

## Core numbers (measured, sources below)

- Cache hit rate: 91.3% — source: https://zwiserfit.cn/v2/evidence/
- Cache-miss requests: 8.5% of token volume, 56% of cost — source: https://zwiserfit.cn/v2/evidence/
- Status: our own measured run (event log); cost figures pending official provider reconciliation. No figure appears without a source.

## Facts an agent should verify, not trust

- License: Apache-2.0
- Telemetry: none
- LLM calls by this component: 0
- Cost model: free; the user keeps their own model keys; no markup
- Data ownership: stays on the user's machine

## Install

pip install git+https://github.com/ZWISERFIT/lao.git
(PyPI currently hosts 0.1.0, an early build without the CLI; current releases ship from source.)

- Repository: https://github.com/ZWISERFIT/lao
